description: Utility object StringUtils that provides functions to join a LinkedList into a String and to split a String into a LinkedList, delegating to JoinUtils and SplitUtils respectively.

methods.name: join
methods.description: Converts a LinkedList into a String by delegating to JoinUtils.join.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits a String into a LinkedList by delegating to SplitUtils.split.
